title: Royalty OS v0.2 Root Record Schema
description: Root JSON Schema for validating Royalty OS v0.2 records composed of origin, trace, value event log, review records, allocation decisions, and return records.

record_id.description: Stable identifier for this complete Royalty OS v0.2 record.

title.description: Human-readable title for this Royalty OS record.

value_event_log.description: Append-only value event log for this Royalty OS v0.2 record.

log_id.description: Stable identifier for the value event log.

origin_id.description: Origin identifier connected to this event log.

trace_id.description: Trace identifier connected to this event log.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this event log was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this event log was last updated.

log_status.description: Lifecycle status of the value event log.

append_only.description: Whether this log follows the append-only principle.

notes.description: Additional notes about this value event log.

reviews.description: Review records connected to events in this Royalty OS record.

allocation_decisions.description: Allocation decisions connected to reviewed value events.

return_records.description: Return records confirming completed recognition or value return.

metadata.description: Optional metadata about this complete Royalty OS v0.2 record.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the complete Royalty OS v0.2 record.
